body.x: Max Virtual(www.sugrsugr.com), a manufacturer of wi-fi speakers run by designers, software developers, app & server programmers, and hardware product engineers, unveiled Sugr Cube at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Activated by touch, Sugr Cube can directly access to Internet radio stations, streaming music services, and personal music saved in wi-fi enabled devices. It is built with a 3-inch full-range Neodymium speaker to deliver powerful sound. Its patent-pending music playback control with intuitive gestures provide simplicity and convenience to users, and by using SUGR Cube app, users can set time and music for sleeping and waking up.
